text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: It's finally time! I've been dying to see Oguri Cap and Super Creek compete against each other!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: But with a lineup like this, it's impossible to tell whether Oguri, Creek, Inari One, or Mejiro Ardan will come out on top! The race can't start soon enough!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: Oguriii! Show 'em what you've got! Show 'em you're the best!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: At long last, Inari One can test her mettle against both Oguri Cap and Super Creek. Now's her chance to shake things up and make a name for herself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: Come on, Inari One! I know you've got what it takes to light the Twinkle Series and this generation ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Townswoman
text_block_list.text: Wow, listen to that crowd! I hope Inari's not feelin' nervous.

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she's fine! I'd bet my bottom dollar she'll run this autumn Tenno Sho as well as she always does!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Inari! We're all rootin' for ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is a make-or-break race for those seeking to become Umamusume of the Year, and on top of that, Inari One will be up against Oguri Cap and Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I finally made it…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If I don't blow Oguri 'n' Creek outta the water with an overwhelmin' victory today, I'll miss out on my dream of reachin' the top.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I can't forget that! I have to win here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hesitate, wondering if reassuring her and saying that I know she'll win will be of any use.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One knows Oguri Cap's true strength better than I do since she's the one who raced against her in the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't just placate her with shallow platitudes. There's only one thing I can say, if I'm going to say anything at all.
choice_data_list: Let's… pull out all the stops!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's embarrassing that's the only encouragement I can offer, but I say those words with utmost sincerity in hopes they'll bolster her nerves.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, why do ya look like you're on the verge of tears?! You're the only reason we've gotten this far, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So c'mon. Hold your head up high and be proud, and I'll do the same too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll pull out all the stops jus' like you said 'n' show 'em what I've got! And then…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat Oguri and start makin' my way to the top!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll be back, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (The atmosphere feels so heavy in the paddock. Wait… am I even breathin'?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gah, this is no good. I'm still stuck on what happened at the Mainichi Okan!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. We haven't faced off in a race since the Arima Kinen last year.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Creek… You look even stronger than you did then.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I could say the same about you. I've been really excited to race against you again…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Especially because I'll be the one winning today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Not on my watch. I'll be today's victor.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm such a fool! Just look at how amazing the two of 'em look standin' next to each other!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (But I gotta beat 'em! And I needa win so spectacularly, no one'll have any doubt that I'm the best!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Creek. Lookin' good.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ever since we entered our senior year, I've been looking forward to the day I'd be able to race against you. And now it's finally here! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: With both you and Oguri here, I couldn't have asked for a better autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Neither could I!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll see you later.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I can do it. I've gotta, 'cause Boss 'n' the others all believe in me!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I can do it. I've gotta, 'cause Boss 'n' the others all believe in me!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's time, Inari One! This is the ultimate showdown that'll decide my fate!
